failures.question: What was the cumulative (running total) revenue at the end of each month of 2011?
failures.example_sql:
WITH monthly_rev AS (
    SELECT
        d.year,
        d.month,
        SUM(val.revenue) AS monthly_revenue
    FROM (
        SELECT date_key, revenue FROM retail.fact_sales
        UNION ALL
        SELECT date_key, revenue FROM retail.fact_cancellations
    ) val
    JOIN retail.dim_date d ON val.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year = 2011
    GROUP BY d.year, d.month
)
SELECT
    year,
    month,
    SUM(monthly_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_revenue
FROM monthly_rev
ORDER BY month

failures.question: For each month from February 2011 to November 2011, what was the percentage change in revenue versus the previous month?
failures.example_sql:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        d.year,
        d.month,
        d.month_start,
        SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE s.invoice_date >= '2011-02-01' AND s.invoice_date < '2011-12-01'
    GROUP BY d.year, d.month, d.month_start
),
revenue_with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        month,
        month_start,
        revenue,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year, month) AS prev_revenue
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT 
    to_char(month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_name,
    revenue,
    prev_revenue,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_revenue IS NULL OR prev_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(((revenue - prev_revenue) / prev_revenue) * 100.0, 2)
    END AS percentage_change
FROM revenue_with_lag
ORDER BY year, month
